first_comment: Bonus detail: the gymnasium at Mieza had a covered running track almost two football fields long. Would you have trained there or studied? 🏃‍♂️📜

stories.stat_label: sq ft teaching complex with mosaics
stories.headline: The likely school of Aristotle and Alexander emerges
stories.summary: At Mieza, archaeologists found lecture rooms with stone benches and a 1,700 sq ft complex with mosaic floors at the royal gymnasium where Aristotle is believed to have taught a young Alexander the Great.
stories.why: It's a rare glimpse of the place that shaped one of history's most famous students.

stories.stat_label: separate times water changed the rocks
stories.headline: Mars rocks were reshaped by water 3 separate times
stories.summary: NASA's Perseverance found that rocks at Jezero Crater's old lakeshore were altered by groundwater, lake water and later hot fluids, which left mineral veins up to 25 cm thick.
stories.why: Long-lasting, varied water means more chances that ancient Mars could have supported life.

stories.stat_label: years since the last new penguin
stories.headline: Scientists name the first new penguin in 100+ years
stories.summary: DNA revealed that gentoo penguins are really 4 separate species. The newly named southeastern gentoo, Pygoscelis kerguelensis, lives on the remote Kerguelen Islands.
stories.why: Knowing it's a distinct species means it can now get protection of its own.

stories.stat_label: away, and sharks still heard it
stories.headline: Wild sharks heard a sound from 243 feet away
stories.summary: Filming blacktip sharks with a drone, researchers found they turned away from low-pitched sounds played up to 243 feet away. Across 209 trials with a high tone, they never reacted.
stories.why: It's the first measured proof that free-swimming sharks can hear and locate sounds from afar.

fun_fact: Alexander was only about 13 when Aristotle became his teacher.
